🎥🎬: Twisted Metal (2023)
Imagine driving across the country when literally every other driver wants you dead. That’s life for John Doe, a delivery driver navigating a post-apocalyptic America where heavily armed cars rule the roads and kindness is becoming extinct.
Offered a shot at a better future, John must deliver a mysterious package while battling dangerous road warriors and teaming up with Quiet, a fearless outlaw with her own reasons for surviving. Things get even crazier when Sweet Tooth, a psychotic killer with an ice cream truck, enters the picture.
From insane vehicle battles to bizarre villains and laugh-out-loud violence, Twisted Metal proves that the highway is the last place you want to be stranded.
Twisted Metal is now streaming on Peacock. #SonyPicsPartner
